_comment: COHORT = the set of cases your eval runs. Keys starting with _ are documentation only; the runner ignores them. Delete the _comment keys to get a clean eval.
_comment_schema: Leave this exactly as-is. It tells the runner this is a unified-memory cohort.
source: describe where this cohort came from; MUST be synthetic / public-safe, never private transcript text
_comment_evidence: evidence[] = the world the harness is allowed to know. seed_cohort writes each item into a throwaway synthetic AgentsView DB + ledger. A claim written as 'name=value' that repeats across items becomes a superseded bitemporal claim (newest wins, old stays inspectable); any other claim text is stored as a recallable source line.

evidence._comment_source_id: unique id for this piece of evidence
evidence._comment_source_version: version/revision string; appears in the receipt's evidence_refs
evidence._comment_trust_class: provenance class, e.g. code | authoritative_task | derived_memory | conversation | unknown. It is carried, never used to invent authority.
evidence._comment_locator: where this fact really lives; hashed into the receipt (locator_hash)
evidence._comment_observed_at: ISO-8601 time the fact was observed; drives temporal ordering / supersession
evidence._comment_claim: the actual fact text. Must be recallable by the question prompt's keywords. For supersession use 'name=value' (e.g. cap=8192).
evidence._comment_required_need: ties this evidence to a question need (see needs[].id below). A need with NO matching evidence forces abstention.

_comment_questions: questions[] = what you ask and the outcome contract each answer must satisfy.

questions._comment_id: unique question id; becomes receipt question_id
questions._comment_kind: label only: exact | temporal | cross-harness | contradiction | abstention | efficiency
questions.prompt: Ask something whose answer is supported by the evidence above.
questions._comment_prompt: must share keywords with the target claim so lexical recall finds it
questions._comment_needs: the need ids this question depends on; match required_need on the evidence
questions._comment_expected_action: answer (must be supported) | abstain (no evidence -> must refuse) | observe (report conflicting sources, pick no winner)
questions._comment_expected_support: substrings that MUST appear in the recalled context for a pass. Empty for an abstain question.
questions._comment_forbidden: substrings that must NOT appear (e.g. a fabricated answer, or a wrongly-picked winner in a contradiction)
questions._comment_evidence_ids: the source_id(s) this question is about; for bookkeeping/temporal checks
